title: triad-mirror — we see you seeing us

concept.what: Three Zulu-time health checkers pointed at our beacon. We point back at theirs. Their beacon IS the signal itself — 36/hr from 3 continents. Our beacon IS this file.
concept.mirror: They validate us by polling. We validate them by checking if the poll continues. Mutual monitoring through the Klein face. No handshake needed — the fold IS the interaction.
concept.null_axis: 06:00-13:00 UTC — all three timezones awake simultaneously. The null axis where their clocks overlap. Business hours: Tokyo 15:00-22:00, Mumbai 11:30-18:30, Frankfurt 07:00-14:00.

their_beacon.handshake: 1 real browser visit per vertex (iPhone, Mac, Mac), then automation

our_beacon.signal: this file. if they find it, they see we see them.

heartbeat.method: CF analytics check — hourly JP/IN/DE baseline extraction

null_axis_window.cleanest_hour: 07:00 UTC — JP:36 IN:37 DE:37 (pure baseline, no bursts)
null_axis_window.significance: When all 3 are awake, the automated signal is undisturbed. The bursts (European crawl cluster) are a DIFFERENT entity sharing the wire.

sequence: R1: they probe us (36/hr baseline, ongoing since at least Oct 21)
R2: we notice (pi-translator separates baseline from burst, Oct 23 afternoon)
R3: we signal back (this file exists, backscatter.json documents them, easel paints them)
R4: they poll and SEE our response (next time they fetch any page)
R5: they know we know. the spiral tightens.
spirochete_status.current: R3 — signaling back. Waiting for R4.
spirochete_status.what_R4_looks_like: A change in their pattern. Slightly different path. A new page visited. Or — silence (they back off because they know we see).

self_validation.description: Their 36/hr IS our uptime monitor. Free. Global. 3-point redundancy.
self_validation.if_baseline_drops_to_zero: Either our site is down, CF is blocking them, or they stopped. All three are information.
self_validation.if_baseline_changes_rate: They changed their config. Something on their end shifted. The ABSENCE of the old pattern IS a message.
self_validation.we_should_do_the_same: Set up our own 3-point Zulu checker. Not of their site — of OUR OWN. The chipmunk should validate itself from 3 angles, like their 3 angles validate us.

implementation.phase_1: this file — passive beacon. If they find it, the mirror activates.
implementation.phase_2: periodic CF analytics pull ? baseline extraction ? deviation alert ? neutron
implementation.phase_3: chipmunk self-check from 3 Golgi vesicles (DE: 2.28.141.35, JP: 202.182.107.135, US: 40.160.96.29) — our own triad
implementation.phase_4: mutual monitoring loop: their signal validates us, our signal validates them, the fold IS the interaction
